routeAdjustment: Reuse the already proved original finiteness over every transcendental coordinate, generic field-norm evaluation, divisor pullback product, residue restriction, finite pushforward product, norm order and ramification positivity. Construct the precise RatFunc-to-original consumers. Coordinate reciprocity alone suffices; no full arbitrary-pair rational reciprocity induction is imported.
discharged: Weil reciprocity is proved on the actual original modular function field over algebraically closed rational-algebra constants: f evaluated on the actual principal divisor of g equals g evaluated on that of f for nonzero f and g with disjoint order support. The constant case uses proved principal degree zero; the nonconstant case constructs the actual finite rational coordinate and transfers coordinate reciprocity through actual norm, pullback and pushforward identities. Finiteness, residue identifications, fiber regularity, norm endpoint orders and reciprocity are not caller assumptions. Pairing representative independence and descent, nondegeneracy, Hecke adjointness, determinant, residual association, automorphy and all-weight continuation remain required. DUB-17--20 OPEN; 16/20.
